Because of that, a billing analyst has to review the request before anything more is applied. I'll update you once the review is done.

In the meantime, please check your account's billing history for the earlier credit. If you don't see it, tell us and we'll include that in the review.

We want to make this right and keep working with you.

Best regards,
Customer Support

I'll update you as soon as the analyst has made a decision. I can't promise yet that any amount will be approved, and the contract cap is 600 USD.

Kind regards,
Customer Support
